scope: development-only conditional row/error/block/algorithm-Monte-Carlo cost and precision; not population coverage or pilot power
E_candidate_rule: smallest measured rows with conditional H1 and static mean SE <=10% of absolute A/B development mean separation at maximum rows; engineering scale only, two problems do not estimate population variance; if unresolved retain largest measured rows with limitation
bootstrap_absolute_gate_rule: twice maximum observed absolute endpoint MCSE at selected iteration count; measured finite calibration margin, not a guarantee for unseen teacher distributions
power_scope: existing _power numeric algorithm on observed disjoint E-block mean inputs; declared dimensionless shifts only to exercise Monte Carlo precision, never a study planning effect or prospective teacher power
resident_rule: requested and every actual chunk supported and <=min(128,F) before preparation/measurement
